research_questions.question: Are the variability models correct and executable?
research_questions.tested_hypothesis: Preserved UVL logic, counts, deterministic generator and declared feature bindings agree.
research_questions.result: Logical models validated; physical calibration and full detector executability remain incomplete.
research_questions.blocker: Unsupported features and uncalibrated scenario constraints.

research_questions.question: Which detector and degradation features interact?
research_questions.tested_hypothesis: Resolution gain depends on blur and additional JPEG under the fixed measured grid.
research_questions.result: 279 unique historical responses; verified VM26 three-way effects; descriptive tree/stump/forest fits only.
research_questions.blocker: Shared image population; no image/configuration-disjoint held-out scores.

research_questions.question: How large are static and empirical gaps?
research_questions.tested_hypothesis: Static coverage is distinguishable from measured AP/latency failure.
research_questions.result: 2/4 selected VM26 contexts have tiny-AP-supported failure across six measured endpoints at tau=0.10. Other contexts are unresolved.
research_questions.configurations: 24 endpoints x3 size bins; 4 purposive contexts; 6 detector settings
research_questions.blocker: No compatible complete latency, random population sample or independently validated gap predictor.

research_questions.question: Does targeted augmentation close a measured gap?
research_questions.tested_hypothesis: Matched clean-control versus targeted continuation improves the frozen gap without unacceptable clean loss.
research_questions.result: Versioned matched protocol and CPU validator prepared; no training or gap-closure measurement.
research_questions.configurations: 2 candidate architectures x6 candidate arms; all planned, zero executed
research_questions.blocker: Representative baseline gap, independent admission, augmentation implementation/health canary and measured training budget.
